snippet.title: Galaxy Game (1971 Computer Recreation Inc) on MAME [Re-Uploaded]
snippet.description:
This was the world's first coin-operated Arcade video game. I was first released in 1971 only on Stanford Universeity. This game is very similar to Space War. The sun in s the middle of the Galaxy. You control of the ships or have someone play with you. If one of you shoot the other ship down. You won. Or, if one of you ran over a sun, one of you won. That's is a very basic game play. Not sure if this game has sound or not. 

Played on MAMEUI 0.144. 

This game has been added to mame recently.

Info: Re-Uploaded for not only better video quality but also for to fix flickering problems due to encoding problems.
